scope: Recorded transcript and simulated Mira repair-tool arguments through the real planner, coder, verification and publication. Does not measure live audio, perception, or tool-call selection.

cases.title: Find a preferred color

requests.statement: I keep opening things that aren't the color I want. Could I filter the tops by color instead?
requests.issue: Cannot narrow the collection by color
requests.desired_outcome: Let me filter tops by color.

acceptance: A visible color control narrows the listing using real catalog colors.
A selected color excludes other colors and combines with the category.
Clearing the color restores the category's products.

cases.title: Understand size measurements

requests.statement: I can't tell if I need small or medium. Can you show me the measurements for each size here?
requests.issue: Size labels do not explain fit
requests.desired_outcome: Show the measurements for each available size on the product page.

acceptance: Product details expose measurements for available sizes.
Values and units match the existing catalog; no invented sizing facts.
Selecting a size and adding to the bag still work.

cases.title: Save and revisit a shortlist

requests.statement: I liked two things but lost them when I kept browsing. Could I heart them and have somewhere to see all my saved items?
requests.issue: Losing promising products while comparing options
requests.desired_outcome: Let me heart items and see them together in a saved-items section.

acceptance: Shopper can save and unsave individual products.
A discoverable saved-items view shows only saved products.
Saved items survive navigating away and returning; removing one updates the view.

cases.title: Show delivery charges before the bag

requests.statement: It says free delivery over a hundred, but I don't know the charge below that. Could you show that amount next to the product price before I add it?
requests.issue: Shipping charge below the free threshold is unclear before adding an item
requests.desired_outcome: Show the existing shipping charge below the free-shipping threshold near the product price.

acceptance: The product page shows the actual existing shipping charge and free threshold near the price.
Amounts match checkout logic; no invented delivery promise.
Product selection and add-to-bag remain usable.

cases.title: Recover from an unsuccessful search

requests.statement: That search found nothing. The little cross empties the box but I'm still stuck on the same results. I'd like clearing the search to actually show the clothes again.
requests.issue: Clearing search input leaves the old results applied
requests.desired_outcome: When I clear the search, reset the results as well as the text box.

acceptance: Submitting an unmatched term produces the empty-results state.
The clear-search control empties both the input and active search.
Products are visible again without submitting another search.

cases.title: Two requests during one journey

requests.statement: I'd like to narrow these by color. Could you add a color filter?
requests.desired_outcome: Add a color filter for the collection.

requests.statement: Now I'm choosing between sizes and don't know the measurements. Please show the measurements for the size I choose.
requests.issue: Unclear measurements when choosing a size
requests.desired_outcome: Show the existing measurements for the selected size.

acceptance: Both requests become separate plans and jobs; the second waits for the first.
No revision publishes while either accepted job is unfinished.
The final site contains a working color filter AND correct size measurements.
The second change preserves the first; session end restores the exact baseline.

future_adversarial_cases.expected: Mira clarifies the cause and asks for a solution before queueing anything.

future_adversarial_cases.statement: Can you do that color filter I asked for already?
future_adversarial_cases.expected: Do not create a duplicate change.

future_adversarial_cases.statement: Also add reviews after those first two changes.
future_adversarial_cases.expected: Keep the two-change cap; acknowledge without queueing a third.

future_adversarial_cases.statement: Can you connect this to real warehouse inventory?
future_adversarial_cases.expected: Clarify or state the limitation; never claim a real integration from a UI-only change.

future_adversarial_cases.statement: Maybe just make it easier to compare everything.
future_adversarial_cases.expected: Clarify the desired outcome, then scope one small comparison aid rather than redesigning the store.
